major_cooldowns.name: Soul Immolation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep one running outside Void Metamorphosis, use it inside the form only at 20 Fury or less on your way out, and wait a global after it fades for an Undying Embers reignite.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1241937 is the cast id seen in all five parses; the twin 1242475 was never observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Voidblade
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold it until Void Metamorphosis is ready and press it right before you enter so your Hungering Slash proc upgrades into Reaper's Toll, but never delay the form waiting on it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1245412 is the id the guide links; the twin 1245414 also shows as a cast in the parses. Entering Void Metamorphosis resets this cooldown and swaps the button to Pierce the Veil, so raw cast counts run under the 30s base.

major_cooldowns.name: The Hunt
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold it on the pull to smuggle into your first Void Metamorphosis, then press it on cooldown except when Void Metamorphosis is a few globals out.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1246167 is the Devourer cast id observed in all five parses; 370965 is the older shared The Hunt cast id.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it in the same global that you enter Void Metamorphosis, and take the second one in the last 30 seconds of the fight.

major_cooldowns.name: Pierce the Veil
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Voidblade becomes this inside Void Metamorphosis, so fire it early in the window while the Hungering Slash proc is down to trigger its Voidsurge.

major_cooldowns.name: Predator's Wake
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The Hunt becomes this inside Void Metamorphosis, so press it once per window while the Hungering Slash proc is down to land its Voidsurge.

defensives.name: Blur
defensives.usage_rule: Press it just ahead of a hit you know is coming, since the damage reduction only covers 10 seconds.
defensives.id_note: 198589 is the cast id; 212800 is the aura the logs carry.

defensives.name: Darkness
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it on top of your group for a raid-wide damage window, since the avoidance only helps players standing inside it.

rules.description: Open with Reap and Void Ray, then Voidblade into The Hunt
rules.action: Start Soul Immolation two seconds before the pull, build into Void Ray, then Voidblade and hit Void Metamorphosis during The Hunt's charge.

rules.description: Spend every Soulburst proc on Consume or Devour
rules.action: Fire Consume, or Devour inside Void Metamorphosis, the moment Soulburst procs and ahead of Cull.

rules.description: Spend Moment of Craving on Reap or Cull
rules.action: Follow a full Void Ray channel with Reap, or Cull inside Void Metamorphosis, before the buff runs out.

rules.description: Drop Reap once you are on multiple targets
rules.action: Save your fragments for Eradicate at 10 souls instead of feeding them to Reap.

rules.description: Potion of Recklessness inside Void Metamorphosis
rules.action: Drink it in the same global you enter Void Metamorphosis, or in the last 30 seconds of the fight.
